items.title: 基于大语言模型的业务流程长尾变化应变方法
items.title_zh: 基于大语言模型的业务流程长尾变化应变方法
items.summary_zh: 业务流程应变是业务流程管理的重要任务,旨在通过调整流程模型和实例行为来响应不断变化的环境,从而提高其柔韧性并实现业务目标。建模时,残留不确定性导致的长尾变化无法避免,给传统的业务流程应变技术带来了挑战。目前针对长尾变化最有效的应变方法基于一种三方协作框架,即由负责感知长尾变化和提出应变策略的前端业务人员、负责提供服务接口和合规性要求的后端技术人员和管理层,以及辅助应变实施的工具系统共同协作来应对长尾变化,保障业务目标达成。然而,长尾变化在不同时空条件下的多样性、复杂性和应变的迫切性,极有可能超出前端业务人员在应变时对当前情境的理解能力、依据情境制定应变策略的专业水平,以及将应变策略采用领域专用语言有效表达的熟练程度。为弥补这一缺憾并进一步拓展上述框架,提出了一种基于大语言模型的业务流程长尾变化应变方法LLM-Adapt,充分利用大语言模型的泛化能力、强大的内容生成能力,以及嵌入的事件与对策

extra.description: 业务流程应变是业务流程管理的重要任务,旨在通过调整流程模型和实例行为来响应不断变化的环境,从而提高其柔韧性并实现业务目标。建模时,残留不确定性导致的长尾变化无法避免,给传统的业务流程应变技术带来了挑战。目前针对长尾变化最有效的应变方法基于一种三方协作框架,即由负责感知长尾变化和提出应变策略的前端业务人员、负责提供服务接口和合规性要求的后端技术人员和管理层,以及辅助应变实施的工具系统共同协作来应对长尾变化,保障业务目标达成。然而,长尾变化在不同时空条件下的多样性、复杂性和应变的迫切性,极有可能超出前端业务人员在应变时对当前情境的理解能力、依据情境制定应变策略的专业水平,以及将应变策略采用领域专用语言有效表达的熟练程度。为弥补这一缺憾并进一步拓展上述框架,提出了一种基于大语言模型的业务流程长尾变化应变方法LLM-Adapt,充分利用大语言模型的泛化能力、强大的内容生成能力,以及嵌入的事件与对策知识库,形成一种更高效、灵活的应变机制。首先,以基于长尾变化特征的提示词工程为媒介,使前端业务人员能够通过自然语言与大语言模型进行交互并获得应变方案。其次,结合后端管理层制定的业务基线目标约束对应变方案进行功能性约束验证,提出的SSDT-Lane算法基于流程结构相似性对应变方案进行筛选,消除了大语言模型在流程调整、业务和组织架构匹配等方面面临的幻觉风险。基于合成数据和真实开源数据集的典型案例分析实验显示,LLM-Adapt相比现有方法,在应变准确性、效率、适用性等方面都表现出显著优势。

items.title: AtomicRL: Atomic Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation
items.title_zh: AtomicRL：用于长时程机器人操作的原子强化学习
items.summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人操作中显示出前景，但仅靠模仿学习（IL）往往难以掌握复杂的长时程技能。强化学习（RL）为进一步改进VLA策略提供了有效途径。然而，现有VLA-RL方法通常因轨迹级稀疏奖励而遭受延迟和有偏的信用分配，同时子任务掌握不均衡造成瓶颈，限制整体性能。为应对这些挑战，我们提出AtomicRL，一个利用原子任务结构实现可靠信用分配和自适应探索的RL后训练框架。AtomicRL引入语义感知策略优化（SAPO），使用语义感知门控约束失败原子子任务的TD残差跨任务边界传播，减轻信用污染，同时保留子任务内信用分配和价值引导。此外，瓶颈自适应目标探索（BATE）根据各原子子任务的掌握程度动态协调任务采样和局部探索激励，将学习导向剩余瓶颈。最后，我们开发了Real2Sim2Real流程，将仿真中的在线RL与真实世界部署衔接，促进向物理机器人的实际迁移。在LIBERO-LONG

extra.description: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown promise in robotic manipulation, but imitation learning (IL) alone often struggles to master complex long-horizon skills. Reinforcement learning (RL) offers an effective avenue for further improving VLA policies. However, existing VLA-RL methods typically suffer from delayed and biased credit assignment due to trajectory-level sparse rewards, while imbalanced subtask mastery creates bottlenecks that limit overall performance. To address these challenges, we propose AtomicRL, an RL post-training framework that leverages atomic task structures for reliable credit assignment and adaptive exploration. AtomicRL introduces Semantic-Aware Policy Optimization (SAPO), which uses semantic-aware gating to constrain TD residuals from failed atomic subtasks from propagating across task boundaries, mitigating credit contamination while preserving intra-subtask credit assignment and value bootstrapping. In addition, Bottleneck-Adaptive Target Exploration (BATE) dynamically coordinates task sampling and local exploration incentives based on the mastery of individual atomic subtasks, directing learning toward the remaining bottlenecks. Finally, we develop a Real2Sim2Real pipeline that bridges online RL in simulation with real-world deployment, facilitating practical transfer to physical robots. On LIBERO-LONG, AtomicRL achieves absolute performance gains of 3.6% and 4.0% over PPO across two VLA architectures. On CALVIN ABC-D, it improves full-task performance by up to 9.5% over PPO. Combined with the Real2Sim2Real pipeline, AtomicRL further improves real-world task performance by an average of 21.3%. These results demonstrate that AtomicRL effectively improves the learning efficiency and manipulation performance of VLA policies on long-horizon tasks.

items.title: BatchBench: Benchmarking AI Robustness to Batch Effects and Domain Shift in Biomedical Images - A JUMP Cell Painting Leaderboard
items.title_zh: BatchBench：基准测试AI对生物医学图像中批次效应和域偏移的鲁棒性——JUMP Cell Painting排行榜
items.summary_zh: 尽管近期取得进展，当前AI系统仍极易受域偏移影响，尤其在生物医学成像中，图像通常在显著不同的实验条件下采集。尽管近期域适应方法已取得实质进展，域偏移下的显著性能差距仍然存在。为衡量这方面的进展，我们推出BatchBench，一个评估和比较AI系统在来自未见实验批次和数据源的生物医学图像上鲁棒性的排行榜。BatchBench基于JUMP-CP构建，这是最大的公开生物医学成像数据集之一。JUMP-CP使用Cell Painting assay生成，表现出明显的批次效应和域偏移，使其成为评估对分布变化鲁棒性的挑战性测试平台。

extra.description: Despite recent advances, current AI systems remain highly susceptible to domain shifts, particularly in biomedical imaging, where images are usually acquired under substantially different experimental conditions. Although recent domain adaptation methods have made substantial progress, significant performance gaps under domain shift persist. To measure progress in this regard, we introduce BatchBench, a leaderboard that evaluates and compares the robustness of AI systems on biomedical images from unseen experimental batches and data sources. BatchBench is built on JUMP-CP, one of the largest publicly available biomedical imaging datasets. Generated using the Cell Painting assay, JUMP-CP exhibits pronounced batch effects and domain shifts, making it a challenging testbed for evaluating robustness to distributional changes.

items.title: Schrödinger-Bass Bridge Barycenter Models for Measure-Valued Data
items.title_zh: 面向测度值数据的 Schrödinger-Bass 桥重心模型
items.summary_zh: 基于概率测度间随机和确定性最优传输桥的重心模型已被证明对（概率）测度值数据的监督和无监督学习有用。本文利用最近提出的两测度间 Schrödinger-Bass 桥（SBB）中出现的方向不对称和对偶漂移扩散控制，提出 \textit{SBB-encoder}、\textit{SBB-decoder}、\textit{SBB-symmetric} 和 \textit{SBB-Markovian} 重心模型。对每个新模型，我们的第一个理论结果在温和假设下建立 SBB 重心的存在性。第二个理论结果刻画高斯的解码器 SBB 重心，我们证明对高斯输入测度，解码器形式允许高斯极小化子，将重心计算简化为有限维优化并产生紧凑算法。对一般输入测度，我们使用 SBB 对偶表示为所有四种形式推导混合 Wasserstein 梯度粒子下降方案。最后，我们利用这些算法求解空间图像和单细胞 RNA 测序数据中出现的分布

extra.description: Barycenter models, based on stochastic and deterministic optimal transport bridges between probability measures, have proven to be useful for supervised and unsupervised learning for (probability) measure-valued data. In this paper, we utilize the directional asymmetry and dual drift-diffusion control arising in the recently proposed Schrödinger-Bass Bridge (SBB) between two measures, and propose \textit{SBB-encoder}, \textit{SBB-decoder}, \textit{SBB-symmetric}, and \textit{SBB-Markovian} barycenter models. For each of these novel models, our first theoretical result establishes the existence of the SBB-barycenter under mild assumptions. Our second theoretical result characterizes the decoder SBB-barycenter of Gaussians where we show that for Gaussian input measures, the decoder formulation admits a Gaussian minimizer, reducing barycenter computation to a finite-dimensional optimization and yielding a compact algorithm. For general input measures, we derive a hybrid Wasserstein gradient particle descent scheme for all four formulations using the SBB dual representation. Finally, we utilize these algorithms for solving distributional-inverse/interpolation problems arising in the context of spatial images and single-cell RNA sequencing data, where we show that the SBB-decoder and Markovian barycenter allow us to interpolate between successive time points. Results show that our method outperforms existing barycenter models for measure interpolation and inference.

items.title: LongZero: Enhancing Long-Context Reasoning in LLMs from Zero Data
items.title_zh: LongZero：从零数据增强LLM长上下文推理
items.summary_zh: 强化学习（RL）是增强大语言模型（LLM）长上下文推理的有效方法，但需要长、多样、有挑战且可验证的训练数据。此类数据的人工标注昂贵，自然出现的数据过于稀缺，无法支撑RL，而现有合成方法依赖外部语料或更强的教师模型，随着被训练模型变强，这些越来越难以获得。近期，从零数据RL——模型从自己提出的任务中学习——已取得优异性能，但现有方法针对短上下文任务。因此，我们提出$\textbf{LongZero}$，一种让LLM在无任何外部数据的情况下提升自身长上下文推理的方法。LongZero不是基于现有文档写问题和答案，而是先让模型以紧凑结构化形式合成问题、答案及其支持证据，然后单独将证据扩展为长多文档上下文。LongZero将这些自写多跳推理任务与自写多轮检索任务结合，并用GRPO训练模型。我们在两个LLM上跨五个长上下文推理基准评估LongZero，并与基于外部语料合成数据的RL比较。实验结果表明

extra.description: Reinforcement learning (RL) is an effective way to strengthen the long-context reasoning of large language models (LLMs), but it needs training data that are long, diverse, challenging, and verifiable. Human annotation of such data is expensive, naturally occurring data are too scarce to sustain RL, and existing synthesis methods depend on external corpora or stronger teacher models, which become harder to obtain as the trained models get stronger. Recently, RL from zero data, in which a model learns from tasks it proposes itself, has achieved excellent performance, but existing methods target short-context tasks. Therefore, we propose $\textbf{LongZero}$, a method that lets an LLM improve its own long-context reasoning without any external data. Instead of writing questions and answers over existing documents, LongZero first has the model synthesize the question and answer with its supporting evidence in a compact structured form, and only then separately expands the evidence into a long multi-document context. LongZero combines these self-written multi-hop reasoning tasks with self-written multi-round retrieval tasks and trains the model with GRPO. We evaluate LongZero on two LLMs across five long-context reasoning benchmarks and compare it with RL on data synthesized from external corpora. Experimental results show that LongZero can generalize to real tasks, and outperforms both baselines, suggesting a viable and promising path to improving long-context reasoning of LLMs.

items.title: Think Harder Where It Matters: Item-Level Adaptive Recursion for Sequential Recommendation
items.title_zh: 在关键处更深入思考：面向序列推荐的物品级自适应递归
items.summary_zh: 现有序列推荐器通常为用户交互历史中的每个物品分配固定计算预算，而不论该物品对最终预测的贡献。我们通过两项诊断发现挑战这一事实上的设计。（1）非均匀计算需求：同一序列内的物品所需计算量差异巨大。大多数在浅层处理后收敛，而关键少数仅在全深度时稳定。（2）固定分配次优：在可获知目标物品的oracle条件下，非均匀深度分配始终优于固定分配，表明现有均匀计算既在已收敛物品上浪费容量，又牺牲整体推荐质量。这些观察促使从固定深度计算转向物品级自适应推理。为此，我们提出LoopRec。LoopRec递归应用单个权重共享块，并在每个递归边界引入轻量门控，对每个物品独立做出二元退出或继续决策。表示已充分成熟的物品提前退出，而需要更深推理的物品继续后续递归。该设计将固定全局深度转化为学习的逐物品属性，无需辅助深度标签，且易于适配多种骨干架构。在公开基准上对四个骨干系列的广泛实验表明，LoopRec始终优于匹配的

extra.description: Existing sequential recommenders usually allocate a fixed computational budget to every item in a user's interaction history, regardless of the item's contribution to the final prediction. We challenge this de facto design with two diagnostic findings. (1) Non-uniform computational need: items within the same sequence vary drastically in how much computation they require. Most converge after shallow processing while a critical minority only stabilizes at full depth. (2) Suboptimality of fixed allocation: given oracle access to the target item, a non-uniform depth assignment consistently outranks the fixed one, indicating that existing uniform computation both wastes capacity on already-converged items and sacrifices overall recommendation quality. These observations motivate a shift from fixed-depth computation to item-level adaptive reasoning. To this end, we propose LoopRec. LoopRec recursively applies a single weight-shared block and introduces a lightweight gate at each recursion boundary that makes a binary exit-or-continue decision for every item independently. Items whose representations have sufficiently matured exit early, while those requiring deeper reasoning continue to subsequent recursions. This design converts the fixed global depth into a learned, per-item property without auxiliary depth labels, and is readily adaptable to diverse backbone architectures. Extensive experiments on public benchmarks with four backbone families demonstrate that LoopRec consistently outperforms matched fixed-depth counterparts. Further analysis reveals that LoopRec's learned allocation exhibits interpretable patterns aligned with our post-hoc oracle analysis: lower-frequency items and more recent interactions naturally receive deeper computation. Our code is available at https://github.com/Elpmis117/LoopRec.

items.title: Environment Duels: A Microcosm of LLM Co-Evolution
items.title_zh: 环境对决：LLM共同进化的微观世界
items.summary_zh: 通过真实世界交互的复杂网络，从合成训练流程到开放网络共享的数据，前沿LLM吸收其前身和竞争者创造的内容。每个模型作为创造者和求解者在生态系统中扮演角色的表现如何？我们推出Environment Duels，一个动态智能体基准，在交互环境中评估这两种能力。每个模型编写环境，每个环境带有一个特权提示，目标是让有能力的求解者在无提示时失败、有提示时通过。在九个前沿LLM中，求解和编写被证明是不同技能：最强求解者并非最强编写者，而较小模型从他人玩法中学到更多，并编写出最难的环境和最有用的提示。除分数外，成对交互构成模型如何相互影响的微观世界。正面对决结果具有传递性，因而产生稳定排名；独立编写者收敛到相同设计；在一项使用Qwen3.8-27B的强化学习研究中，学习者在某编写者环境上的提示提升，与该环境训练在留出推理和智能体基准上对其提升程度相关，无论环境是自身还是另一模型的。这些模式各自都能在模型于

extra.description: Through a tangle of real-world interactions, from synthetic training pipelines to data shared on the open web, frontier LLMs absorb what their predecessors and competitors create. How well does each model play its role in this ecosystem, as a creator and as a solver? We introduce Environment Duels, a dynamic agentic benchmark that evaluates both capabilities on interactive environments. Each model writes environments, each with a privileged hint, aiming for tasks that capable solvers fail without the hint and pass with it. Across nine frontier LLMs, solving and authoring prove to be distinct skills: the strongest solvers are not the strongest authors, while smaller models learn more from how others played and write the hardest environments and the most useful hints. Beyond the scores, the pairwise interactions form a microcosm of how models affect one another. Head-to-head outcomes are transitive and so yield a stable ranking; independent authors converge on the same designs; and in a reinforcement-learning study with Qwen3.8-27B, the learner's hint lift on an author's environments tracks how much training on those environments improves it on held-out reasoning and agentic benchmarks, whether the environments are its own or another model's. Each of these patterns has a counterpart in how models shape one another outside the duel. By staging these interactions under controlled conditions, Environment Duels offers a window onto how LLMs teach, challenge and learn from one another. Code is available at https://github.com/LLM-Duels/EnvDuels.

items.title: Quant-Arena: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Quantitative Trading Research
items.title_zh: Quant-Arena：基准测试 LLM 代理的量化交易研究
items.summary_zh: 量化研究是一个迭代循环：研究人员提出市场假设，将其实现为可执行信号，在历史数据上测试，并决定保留什么。现有基准测试评分公式、代码或单个交易决策，但未解决大型语言模型（LLMs）能否完成这一循环并产生在研究期之外有效的策略。我们介绍 Quant-Arena，一个基于真实 A 股市场数据进行端到端量化研究的基准和公共排行榜。模型构建特征和股票评分代码，仅接收 2022-2023 年的反馈，并冻结一个策略用于在封存的 2024 年进行评估。现金账户评估器应用交易约束和成本，包括从模拟订单簿估计的市场影响。分数主要由实现的超额收益主导，并辅以信号质量和策略使用的特征多样性。我们评估了九个前沿模型，其中 GPT-6 Astra 得分最高；然而，没有模型在 2024 年击败等权重市场。Quant-Arena 开放接受任何模型或代理框架的提交。

extra.description: Quantitative research is an iterative loop: a researcher proposes a market hypothesis, implements it as an executable signal, tests it on historical data, and decides what to keep. Existing benchmarks score formulas, code, or individual trading decisions, leaving open whether large language models (LLMs) can complete this loop and produce strategies that work beyond the research period. We introduce Quant-Arena, a benchmark and public leaderboard for end-to-end quantitative research on real A-share market data. A model constructs features and stock-scoring code, receives feedback only on 2022--2023, and freezes one strategy for assessment on the sealed year 2024. A cash-account evaluator applies trading constraints and costs, including market impact estimated from a simulated order book. Scores are dominated by realized excess return and complemented by signal quality and the diversity of features used by the strategy. We evaluate nine frontier models, among which GPT-6 Astra scores highest; yet no model beats the equal-weight market in 2024. Quant-Arena is open to submissions from any model or agent harness.

items.title: Multimodal Embodied Agents: A Unified Capability-centric Perspective from Computer-Use to Robot-Use
items.title_zh: 多模态具身代理：从计算机使用到机器人使用的统一能力中心视角
items.summary_zh: 多模态代理（MMAs）通过推理、记忆、工具和反馈维持交互，最明显的是作为计算机使用代理，而机器人系统（RSs）在物理动力学下耦合感知和驱动。我们将多模态具身代理（MMEAs）定义为将多模态任务推理与物理行动耦合，并根据由此产生的反馈修正决策的目标导向系统。这引发了一个核心问题：当多模态代理从计算机使用转向机器人使用时，什么发生了变化？我们引入 PAPAV，一个统一的能力中心框架，包含五个反复出现的功能：感知当前状态、预测行动效果、规划可行路线、通过接口或身体行动、验证结果。这些能力按功能而非架构定义，使 PAPAV 能够识别三者共享的内容，然后比较 MMEAs 与 MMAs 和 RSs。五个物理约束，从部分可观测性到不可验证的结果，使得预先固定的选择更少，逆转错误的空间更小。在 64 个基准测试中，显式评估集中在 Act；只有 5 个评估 Anticipate，3 个评估 Verify，两

extra.description: Multimodal agents (MMAs) sustain interaction through reasoning, memory, tools, and feedback, most visibly as computer-use agents, while robotic systems (RSs) couple sensing and actuation under physical dynamics. We define multimodal embodied agents (MMEAs) as goal-directed systems that couple multimodal task reasoning with physical action and revise decisions from the resulting feedback. This raises a central question: what changes when a multimodal agent moves from computer-use to robot-use? We introduce PAPAV, a unified capability-centric framework of five recurring functions: Perceive the current state, Anticipate action effects, Plan a feasible course, Act through an interface or body, and Verify the outcome. Defined by function rather than architecture, these capabilities let PAPAV identify what all three share and then compare MMEAs with MMAs and with RSs. Five physical constraints, from partial observability to unverifiable outcomes, leave fewer choices fixed in advance and less room to reverse errors. Across 64 benchmarks, explicit evaluation centers on Act; only 5 assess Anticipate and 3 assess Verify, leaving both largely hidden behind task success. These constraints also frame the open challenges we identify. PAPAV therefore provides a common basis for designing reliable physical agents and measuring progress across all five capabilities rather than task success alone.

items.title: Velocity Ambiguity Profiles: Time-Resolved Bayes-Risk Diagnostics for Flow Matching
items.title_zh: 速度模糊性剖面：流匹配的时间分辨贝叶斯风险诊断
items.summary_zh: 流匹配训练一系列速度回归问题，但通常报告在插值时间上平均的损失，掩盖了哪些区域受内在模糊性限制，哪些仍受数据限制。我们引入速度模糊性剖面（VAP），$\mathcal{A}_v(t)$，速度预测的时间局部贝叶斯风险下限，并将时间分辨损失分解为 $L_N(t)=\mathcal{A}_v(t)+R(t;N)$，其中只有超额项 $R(t;N)$ 可以通过更多数据或不同估计器减少。对于 $N$ 个训练样本和结构化示例中的 $K$ 分量混合，我们证明了两个统计基准。在内在局部回归基准中，$\mathcal{A}_v(t)$ 进入标准非参数速率的时间依赖噪声因子。在分离的各向同性高斯混合中，贝叶斯速度变为局部仿射，标签预言机残差回归基准具有参数超额风险尺度 $K\mathcal{A}_v(t)/N$，在同一分离残差高斯位置子问题中匹配。受控高斯混合实验通过密集过渡扫描、校准的预言机到盲和实证代理审计

extra.description: Flow matching trains a continuum of velocity regression problems but usually reports a loss averaged over interpolation time, obscuring which regions are limited by intrinsic ambiguity and which remain data-limited. We introduce the Velocity Ambiguity Profile (VAP), $\mathcal{A}_v(t)$, the time-local Bayes-risk floor of velocity prediction, and decompose time-resolved loss as $L_N(t)=\mathcal{A}_v(t)+R(t;N)$, where only the excess term $R(t;N)$ is reducible by more data or a different estimator. For $N$ training samples and a $K$-component mixture in the structured example, we prove two statistical benchmarks. In an intrinsic local-regression benchmark, $\mathcal{A}_v(t)$ enters the time-dependent noise factor of the standard nonparametric rate. In separated isotropic Gaussian mixtures, the Bayes velocity becomes locally affine, and a label-oracle residual-regression benchmark has parametric excess-risk scale $K\mathcal{A}_v(t)/N$, matched within the same separated residual Gaussian-location subproblem. Controlled Gaussian-mixture experiments validate this diagnostic through a dense transition sweep, calibrated oracle-to-blind and empirical-proxy audits, and a local controlled time-sampler stress test in which a frozen reducible-error proxy reduces reducible loss while cross-cell sensitivity delimits aggressive sampling. On CIFAR-100 DINOv2 feature flow, guided time sampling reduces uniformly evaluated velocity loss by $6.78\%$ and global feature Fréchet distance (FD) by $23.6\%$, while class-conditional kernel inception distance (KID) shows no improvement. VAP turns an averaged flow-matching objective into a time-resolved diagnostic for locating ambiguity-limited and data-limited regions.

items.title: Asymmetric On-Policy Distillation Learns In-Context Exploration
items.title_zh: 非对称在策略蒸馏学习上下文探索
items.summary_zh: 部分可观测性下的序列决策很困难，因为代理必须探索以推断隐藏的、任务相关的信息，然后才能有效行动。通过在线强化学习从零开始学习这种信息收集行为样本效率低，而离线模仿在隐藏状态上平均专家动作，无法学习探索。在这项工作中，我们提出 ASTEROID，一个简单有效的学生-教师监督学习框架，可以学习测试时探索。尽管特权专家从不需要探索，我们证明历史条件的学生可以在在策略上下文训练时学会这样做：学生首先在部分可观测性下收集在策略上下文，特权专家根据该上下文提供动作标签。通过直接根据学生的在策略历史蒸馏专家动作，学生学会系统地解决部分可观测性，即在不确定时搜索，一旦隐藏状态揭示就利用。这使得高效的测试时探索（类似于贝叶斯后验采样）成为可能，而不会产生强化学习不切实际的训练数据成本。在包括离散探索基准、机器人操作、导航和 Procgen 环境在内的十一个不同环境中，ASTEROID 在固定探索预算下实现约

extra.description: Sequential decision-making under partial observability is difficult because agents must explore to infer hidden, task-relevant information before acting effectively. Learning such information-gathering behaviors tabula rasa via online reinforcement learning is sample-inefficient, whereas offline imitation averages expert actions across hidden states and fails to learn exploration. In this work, we propose ASTEROID, a simple and effective student--teacher supervised learning framework that can learn test-time exploration. Although a privileged expert never needs to explore, we demonstrate that a history-conditioned student can learn to do so when trained with on-policy contexts: the student first collects on-policy context under partial observability, and the privileged expert provides action labels conditioned on that context. By distilling expert actions directly conditioned on the student's on-policy history, the student learns to systematically resolve partial observability, i.e., search while uncertain and exploit once the hidden state is revealed. This enables efficient test-time exploration (similar to Bayesian posterior sampling) without incurring the impractical training-data costs of reinforcement learning. Across a diverse range of eleven different environments, including discrete exploration benchmarks, robotic manipulation, navigation, and Procgen environments, ASTEROID achieves ~2x higher returns under fixed exploration budgets, uses ~100x fewer interactions than RL baselines, and outperforms frontier models at exploration. Finally, our method transfers policies trained in simulation to vision-denied real-world robot manipulation, exhibiting efficient exploration and increasing success by +40% over standard distillation. Overall, it provides a simple yet surprisingly effective framework to learn efficient test-time exploration.

items.title: Differentially Private Sparse Reward Estimation with Preference Feedback
items.title_zh: 具有偏好反馈的差分隐私稀疏奖励估计
items.summary_zh: 基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）已成为将大型语言模型与人类价值观对齐的核心范式。然而，对敏感偏好数据的依赖需要严格的差分隐私（DP）保证以防止用户信息泄露。现有的私有对齐方法通常假设密集奖励参数化，导致估计误差界限随环境{模型大小 $d$}多项式缩放。这种依赖在现代{过度参数化模型}中是 prohibitive 的，其中 $d$ 巨大。在这项工作中，我们研究\emph{私有稀疏 RLHF}问题以解决这一限制，假设人类偏好（奖励模型）由 $s^* \ll d$ 相关特征的子集支配。我们提供了第一个全面的理论框架，用于在 Bradley-Terry-Luce 模型下从成对偏好反馈进行差分隐私稀疏奖励估计，并引入了 Sample-DP 和 Label-DP 设置的高效算法。理论上，在平方 $\ell_2$ 参数估计误差下，我们建立了基于随机响应的 $(\varepsilon,δ)$-Sampl

extra.description: Reinforcement Learning with Human Feedback (RLHF) has become a central paradigm for aligning Large Language Models with human values. However, the reliance on sensitive preference data necessitates rigorous differential privacy (DP) guarantees to prevent user information leakage. Existing private alignment methods typically assume dense reward parameterizations, resulting in estimation error bounds that scale polynomially with the ambient {model size $d$}. Such dependence is prohibitive in modern {overparameterized models} where $d$ is vast. In this work, we study \emph{Private Sparse RLHF} problem to address this limitation, assuming that human preferences (reward model) are governed by a subset of $s^* \ll d$ relevant features. We provide the first comprehensive theoretical framework for differentially private sparse reward estimation from pairwise preference feedback under the Bradley-Terry-Luce model, and introduce efficient algorithms for both Sample-DP and Label-DP settings. Theoretically, under the squared $\ell_2$ parameter estimation error, we establish upper bounds of $\widetilde{O}(s^*/n + {s^*}^2/n^2\varepsilon^2)$ for $(\varepsilon,δ)$-Sample-DP and $\widetilde{O}(s^*/n + s^*/n\varepsilon^2)$ for $\varepsilon$-Label-DP based on randomized response, where $n$ is the training data size. For the lower bounds, we show that the Sample-DP rate is nearly optimal, and that the guarantee for our Label-DP method cannot be further improved within the randomized-response framework. We also provide a general lower bound for the problem with Label-DP. Empirically, our framework demonstrates superior efficacy over dense baselines across sentiment generation and safety alignment benchmarks, offering a significantly more favorable privacy-utility trade-off.

items.title: VX-One: Typed, Calibrated Decision Heads for Real-Time Perimeter Triage - An empirical study of unknown-attack honesty, cascade gray zones, and calibration under drift
items.title_zh: VX-One：用于实时边界分类的类型化、校准决策头 - 关于未知攻击诚实性、级联灰色区域和漂移下校准的实证研究
items.summary_zh: 边界分类面临延迟/语义权衡：签名引擎快速且格式安全，但对未见攻击视而不见，而生成模型具有语义但速度慢且产生不可解析的输出。2026 年末，一类商业 System One 决策模型（TypeSafe Jev；Microsoft-Decision-1）开始将类型化决策原语 - 二元门、闭集选择、序数分数 - 作为产品 API 出售，没有学术处理。我们提出 VX-One：一个小型多头网络（100K-10M 参数），其输出是这些原语 - 一个校准门、一个在始终包含显式未知选项的闭候选集上的选择，以及一个序数分数，多任务训练，每个头温度校准（CPU 上约 0.7-1.7 ms p50）。我们在 UNSW-NB15、CIC-IDS2017、EMBER2024 上评估它，与校准的 XGBoost、Random-Forest、MLP、Kitsune 对比，并测量在 CIC-IDS2017 五天内的两阶段级

extra.description: Perimeter triage faces a latency/semantics trade-off: signature engines are fast and format-safe but blind to unseen attacks, while generative models are semantic but slow and produce unparseable output. In late 2026 a class of commercial System One decision models (TypeSafe Jev; Microsoft-Decision-1) began selling typed decision primitives - binary gates, closed-set choices, ordinal scores - as product APIs, with no academic treatment. We present VX-One: a small multi-head network (100K-10M parameters) whose outputs are these primitives - a calibrated gate, a choice over a closed candidate set that always includes an explicit unknown option, and an ordinal score, trained multi-task, temperature-calibrated per head (~0.7-1.7 ms p50 on CPU). We evaluate it on UNSW-NB15, CIC-IDS2017, EMBER2024 against calibrated XGBoost, Random-Forest, MLP, Kitsune, and measure a two-phase cascade (Suricata with 52,674 Emerging-Threats rules -> VX-One) over five days of CIC-IDS2017. Findings: (i) VX-One wins detection (AUROC/FPR@95%TPR) on UNSW-NB15 and under temporal drift on CIC-IDS2017 (0.711 vs 0.637), but XGBoost wins multi-class attribution on all three benchmarks; (ii) leave-one-family-out gate detects never-seen families on 9/9 UNSW folds yet drops below chance on CIC recon family, and abstention threshold transfers poorly across benchmarks; (iii) on payload-less reconstructions signature engines resolve ~0.1% of flows - gray zone ~99.9% of traffic, recovered by Phase 2 (combined recall >=0.978); (iv) calibration collapses under temporal drift (ECE 0.04->0.40) for every method while ranking partially survives. We provide a measured account of where typed calibrated decisions help perimeter triage, and where they fail.

items.title: Charts as Epistemic Actions for Experience-Driven Agentic Data Analysis
items.title_zh: 图表作为经验驱动代理数据分析的认知行动
items.summary_zh: 基于 ReAct 风格循环构建的数据代理现在在结构化数据上执行复杂的分析工作流，但它们的中间推理仍然几乎完全通过文本进行。人类分析师则在数字、表格和图表之间移动，阅读视觉证据以揭示文本摘要遗漏的趋势和异常。我们询问图表是否可以在数据代理的推理循环中作为内部认知行动，以及如何教代理使用它们。我们首先构建 \probe{}，一个包含 200 个受控任务的套件，在四种匹配的界面条件下，发现代理能阅读的内容与它们选择使用的内容之间存在持续差距。代理从自生成图表中得分与从数值输出中得分一样好，但仅绘图访问并不能转化为一致的使用。任务切片显示图表在时间、模式和异常推理上领先，而文本在精确阅读和条件验证上领先。然后我们提出 \method{}，它从条件轨迹 rollout 中蒸馏两族经验。一族记录如何选择和验证分析操作，另一族记录何时调用文本、图表或两者。轨迹评判器评分结果并标记中间步骤，验证门只接纳能

extra.description: Data agents built on ReAct-style loops now execute complex analytical workflows over structured data, yet their intermediate reasoning still runs almost entirely through text. Human analysts instead move between numbers, tables, and charts, reading visual evidence to expose trends and anomalies that text summaries drop. We ask whether charts can serve as internal epistemic actions inside a data agent's reasoning loop, and how to teach an agent to use them. We first build \probe{}, a suite of 200 controlled tasks under four matched interface conditions, and find a persistent gap between what agents can read and what they choose to use. Agents score as well from self-generated charts as from numeric output, yet plotting access alone does not translate into consistent use. Task slices show that charts lead on temporal, pattern, and anomaly reasoning, while text leads on precise reading and conditional verification. We then propose \method{}, which distils two families of experience from conditioned trajectory rollouts. One family records how to select and verify analytical operations, and the other records when to invoke text, charts, or both. A trajectory judge scores outcomes and labels intermediate steps, and a validation gate admits only experience that improves held-out performance. On three held-out benchmarks with four LLM backbones, \method{} raises analytical accuracy and visual evidence quality over matched baselines, and backbones that never drew charts begin using them, all without touching model parameters.

items.title: From Reasoning to Action: Benchmarking Frontier AI Models on LIBERO-10 Robot Manipulation Tasks
items.title_zh: 从推理到行动：在 LIBERO-10 机器人操作任务上基准测试前沿 AI 模型
items.summary_zh: 前沿 AI 模型的最新进展在视觉理解、推理、规划和工具使用方面展示了显著能力，提高了使用通用 AI 模型进行机器人操作而无需任务特定训练的可能性。然而，它们操作能力尚未在标准化机器人基准上系统评估。在本报告中，我们提出了一个统一的闭环操作框架，用于在 LIBERO-10 基准上评估前沿 AI 模型。我们的框架使模型能够直接通过视觉观察、机器人本体感受和结构化工具调用控制机器人，主要通过指定目标末端执行器姿态和夹爪命令，无需任务特定微调或预训练操作技能。我们评估了六个前沿 AI 模型，包括 GPT-6 Astra、GPT-6.1 Sol、GPT-6 Luna、Claude Opus 5、Claude Opus 5.5 和 Gemini-4 Argon，跨越三个推理努力水平，产生 18 种配置和 1,800 个评估回合。我们的结果表明，GPT-6 Astra 达到最高成功率 44%，其次是 G

extra.description: Recent advances in frontier AI models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in visual understanding, reasoning, planning, and tool use, raising the possibility of using general-purpose AI models for robot manipulation without task-specific training. However, their manipulation capabilities have not been systematically evaluated on standardized robotics benchmarks. In this report, we present a unified closed-loop manipulation framework for evaluating frontier AI models on the LIBERO-10 benchmark. Our framework enables models to control a robot directly through visual observations, robot proprioception, and structured tool calls, primarily by specifying target end-effector poses and gripper commands, without task-specific fine-tuning or pretrained manipulation skills. We evaluate six frontier AI models, including GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Luna, Claude Opus 5, Claude Opus 5.5, and Gemini-4 Argon, across three reasoning effort levels, resulting in 18 configurations and 1,800 evaluation episodes. Our results show that GPT-6 Astra achieves the highest success rate of 44%, followed by Gemini-4 Argon at 43%. Increasing reasoning effort generally improves manipulation performance, but the benefits vary across models and come at additional inference cost. We also observe substantial differences across tasks, with models performing relatively well on object placement tasks but struggling with precise spatial arrangements and complex multi-step interactions. These findings demonstrate both the potential and limitations of frontier AI models for robot manipulation, highlighting the challenges of translating reasoning capabilities into reliable physical actions. We release our evaluation framework and experimental results to support reproducible benchmarking and future research on reasoning-based robot manipulation.

items.title: SWE-DIVE: Multi-Turn Coding Agent Evaluation with Dynamic User Simulation
items.title_zh: SWE-DIVE：具有动态用户模拟的多轮编码代理评估
items.summary_zh: 编码代理通常使用一次性、表述良好的提示进行评估。SWE-bench 等基准使用现有 GitHub 问题作为编码代理的输入，并评估代理是否成功解决任务。然而，在现实世界用例中，提示通常不像现有 GitHub 问题那样表述良好或结构化。此外，编码代理会话不限于单个提示；它通常涉及多轮交互，用户迭代添加代理必须满足的新任务和要求。为了基准测试这些能力，我们开发了 SWE-DIVE，一个动态、交互式验证和评估框架，用于在多轮环境中基准测试编码代理。为此，我们引入了一个用户模拟器，可以模拟不同的行为模式并与编码代理通信。我们还引入了一个对话验证器，评估用户模拟器的输出以确定它们是否满足初始要求并引导代理成功解决任务。整个框架嵌入在 Harbor 环境中，该环境编排编码代理、用户模拟器和对话验证器，并执行测试环境以确定代理是否成功解决任务。我们的结果和源代码可在我们的 GitHub 仓库（https:

extra.description: Coding agents are typically evaluated using one-shot, well-formulated prompts. Benchmarks such as SWE-bench use existing GitHub issues as input for a coding agent and evaluate whether the agent successfully solves the task. However, in real-world use cases, prompts are often not as well-formulated or structured as existing GitHub issues. Additionally, a coding agent session is not limited to a single prompt; it typically involves a multi-turn interaction in which the user iteratively adds new tasks and requirements that the agent must fulfill. To benchmark these abilities, we developed SWE-DIVE, a dynamic, interactive validation and evaluation framework for benchmarking coding agents in a multi-turn environment. To achieve this, we introduce a user simulator that can simulate different behavioral patterns and communicate with the coding agent. We also introduce a conversation validator that evaluates the user simulator's outputs to determine whether they fulfill the initial requirements and guide the agent toward successfully solving the task. The entire framework is embedded in a Harbor environment, which orchestrates the coding agent, user simulator, and conversation validator, and executes the test environment to determine whether the agent successfully solves the task. Our results and source code are available in our GitHub repository (https://github.com/lorenzbrehme/swe-dive_usersim).

items.title: What the Author Wrote, What the Agent Reads: Silent Cue Loss in Enterprise Document Ingestion
items.title_zh: 作者写了什么，代理读到了什么：企业文档摄取中的静默线索丢失
items.summary_zh: 企业代理对文档采取行动。在代理能够遵循政策、回答合规问题或提交工单之前，某个摄取层必须将 Word 文件或 PDF 转换为 token - 而该层是部署在野外的代理静默丢失信息的地方。我们表明，每个主流转换器都丢失了一层 - 作者通过文本外观编码的含义 - 并且这种丢失使代理自信地错误而不是明显地不完整。我们构建了一个来自 76 个真实政策文档的任务：恢复作者特别指出的要求，通过确定性匹配器根据文件自身的 OOXML 属性评分，没有 LLM 评判。格式盲摄取从 micro F1 0.690 崩溃到 0.150（docling）和 0.075（纯文本），这一差距在来自两个供应商的六个回答模型中重复 - 五个 Claude 模型跨越 Opus、Sonnet 和 Haiku 层级，以及 OpenAI 的 GPT-5.6。看不到线索的代理会猜测，而 docling 在作者未标记的要求上的假阳性率是

extra.description: Enterprise agents act on documents. Before an agent can follow a policy, answer a compliance question or file a ticket, some ingestion layer must turn a Word file or PDF into tokens - and that layer is where an agent deployed in the wild silently loses information. We show that one layer is lost by every mainstream converter - the meaning an author encodes in how text looks - and that the loss makes agents confidently wrong rather than visibly incomplete. We build a task from 76 real policy documents: recover the requirements the author singled out, scored against the file's own OOXML properties by a deterministic matcher with no LLM judge. Formatting-blind ingestion collapses from micro F1 0.690 to 0.150 (docling) and 0.075 (plain text), a gap that replicates across six answering models from two vendors - five Claude models spanning the Opus, Sonnet and Haiku tiers, and OpenAI's GPT-5.6. An agent that cannot see the cue guesses, and docling's false-positive rate on requirements the author did not flag is four times ours. A span-level leave-one-out localises the loss to two cues - highlight (+0.302) and colour (+0.262), both Holm-adjusted p < 1e-4 - while bold, italic, monospace and strikethrough each sit within +/-0.003 of zero. The same asymmetry appears in PDF. Colour is also the cue no mainstream converter preserves and no parsing benchmark scores, and it is common: 32.8% of 6,460 documents carry a deliberate colour or highlight, 10.3% on an obligation. A pre-registered test shows that typing a cue for the agent adds +0.085 beyond merely preserving it (Holm-adjusted p = 0.049). We validate the labels against rendered page images through an independent modality (kappa = 0.72) and bound what wording alone can achieve (AUC 0.664). For agent builders the practical finding is that ingestion, not reasoning, is where this reliability is won or lost, and that the fix is cheap and measurable.

items.title: ConforFlux: Particle-Guided Trunk Repulsion for Diverse Protein Conformations
items.title_zh: ConforFlux：用于多样蛋白质构象的粒子引导主干排斥
items.summary_zh: 蛋白质结构预测的深度学习模型在单个折叠上达到接近实验的准确性，然而它们的默认推理样本集中在单一主导构象周围。我们引入 ConforFlux，一种用于 Boltz-2 的推理时程序，通过主干单嵌入和配对嵌入上的成对 C-RMSD 排斥梯度耦合并行结构预测轨迹。更新后的主干条件每个后续去噪步骤，无需重新训练模型。在四个构象变化类别上，ConforFlux 将每个状态的成功率比默认 Boltz-2 提高 3-17 个百分点，冲突分数增加。该程序还提高了 OpenFold3 和 Protenix 的覆盖率。在两个参考结构在每个模型训练截止后发布的靶标上，引导提高了所有三个模型对两个状态的覆盖率。在人类多巴胺转运体上，ConforFlux 采样了 500 个默认样本中不存在的向内构象。

extra.description: Deep learning models for protein structure prediction achieve near-experimental accuracy on individual folds, yet their default inference samples concentrate around a single dominant conformation. We introduce ConforFlux, an inference-time procedure for Boltz-2 that couples parallel structure-prediction trajectories through a pairwise C-RMSD repulsion gradient on the trunk's single and pair embeddings. The updated trunk conditions every subsequent denoising step without retraining the model. On four conformational-change categories, ConforFlux improves the per-state success rate over default Boltz-2 by 3-17 percentage points, with increased clashscores. The procedure also improves coverage on OpenFold3 and Protenix. On targets whose two reference structures were released after each model's training cutoff, guidance improves coverage of both states on all three models. On the human dopamine transporter, ConforFlux samples inward conformations absent from 500 default samples.

items.title: Relational Graph Convolutional Networks for Glioblastoma Biomarker Discovery via ceRNA and Copy Number Variation Analysis
items.title_zh: 通过 ceRNA 和拷贝数变异分析发现胶质母细胞瘤生物标志物的关系图卷积网络
items.summary_zh: 胶质母细胞瘤（GBM）是一种高度侵袭性的脑肿瘤，五年生存率为 6.9%，很大程度上归因于缺乏可靠的生物标志物。竞争性内源 RNA（ceRNA）和拷贝数变异（CNV）分析各自具有生物标志物识别潜力，但现有工作将它们分开处理，并未整合多种调控机制。因此，我们在晚期融合集成架构下将关系图卷积网络（RGCNs）应用于 ceRNA 和 CNV 知识图谱。在 10 折交叉验证中，RGCN 在测试的图架构中区分最佳（AUCROC 0.874 {+/-} 0.070），显著超过图卷积、图注意力和关系注意力网络。在决策层结合 ceRNA 和 CNV 分支给出了最佳整体性能（AUCROC 0.883 {+/-} 0.072；PR-AUC 0.208 {+/-} 0.152），并在精确率-召回率方面优于仅 ceRNA 模型，尽管该改进在多重比较校正后不存活，因此我们将其报告为提示性。将晚期融合排名与现有胶质瘤文

extra.description: Glioblastoma (GBM) is a highly aggressive brain tumor with a five-year survival rate of 6.9%, attributable in substantial part to the shortage of reliable biomarkers. Competing endogenous RNA (ceRNA) and copy number variation (CNV) analyses each carry biomarker-identification potential, but existing work treats them separately and does not integrate multiple regulatory mechanisms. We therefore applied relational graph convolutional networks (RGCNs) to ceRNA and CNV knowledge graphs under a late-fusion ensemble architecture. Across 10-fold cross-validation the RGCN discriminated best among the graph architectures tested (AUCROC 0.874 {+/-} 0.070), significantly exceeding graph convolutional, graph attention and relational attention networks. Combining the ceRNA and CNV branches at the decision level gave the best overall performance (AUCROC 0.883 {+/-} 0.072; PR-AUC 0.208 {+/-} 0.152) and improved on the ceRNA-only model in precision--recall terms, although that improvement does not survive correction for multiple comparisons and we therefore report it as suggestive. Screening the late-fusion ranking against the existing glioma literature left five candidates that are absent from the curated glioblastoma biomarker set and the subject of at most one prior glioma report, among them hsa-miR-203b and hsa-miR-5683, each differentially expressed by more than fivefold on a log_2 scale. All five are computational predictions. Relational graph learning over a ceRNA network, combined with genomic dosage at the decision level, is thus a workable framework for biomarker prioritization, and the five loci give targeted experimental work a place to start.

items.title: Combinatorial regulation of cellular rotation by CUL-3-actomyosin-dependent oriented division, eggshell geometry, and Ras-MAPK signaling during dorsal-ventral axis establishment in Caenorhabditis elegans
items.title_zh: 秀丽隐杆线虫背腹轴建立过程中 CUL-3-肌动球蛋白依赖性定向分裂、卵壳几何形状和 Ras-MAPK 信号对细胞旋转的组合调控
items.summary_zh: 细胞旋转是一种研究不足的调节动物形态发生的机制。在秀丽隐杆线虫中，背腹轴在两细胞期 AB 细胞在卵壳内旋转并分裂时建立，在四细胞期产生菱形卵裂球排列，使不同的细胞命运特化成为可能。多种机制，包括肌动球蛋白依赖性定向分裂、手性皮层流动和卵壳形状，已被提出调节这种排列，但这些代表冲突假设还是共同作用机制仍不清楚。在这里，我们表明 CUL-3-肌动球蛋白依赖性定向分裂、卵壳几何形状和 Ras-MAPK 信号通路调节细胞旋转的不同步骤。AB 细胞旋转发生在两个不同阶段：阶段 I 在 AB 胞质分裂期间，阶段 II 在相邻 P1 细胞的胞质分裂期间。定量分析揭示 CUL-3-肌动球蛋白依赖性定向分裂是这三种通路中唯一在后期前调节 AB 分裂轴的。肌动球蛋白依赖性定向分裂和卵壳几何形状都是阶段 I 旋转所需的，而阶段 II 旋转独立于卵壳几何形状。我们进一步确定 Ras-MAPK 信号通路是 AB 细

extra.description: Cellular rotation is an understudied mechanism that regulates animal morphogenesis. In C. elegans, the dorsal-ventral axis is established when the two-cell-stage AB cell rotates within the eggshell as it divides, generating the diamond-shaped blastomere arrangement at the four-cell stage that enables distinct cell fate specification. Multiple mechanisms, including actomyosin-dependent oriented division, chiral cortical flow, and eggshell shape, have been proposed to regulate this arrangement, but whether these represent conflicting hypotheses or co-acting mechanisms remains unclear. Here, we show that CUL-3-actomyosin-dependent oriented division, eggshell geometry, and the Ras-MAPK signaling pathway regulate distinct steps of cellular rotation. AB cell rotation occurred in two distinct phases: Phase I during AB cytokinesis and Phase II during cytokinesis of the neighboring P1 cell. Quantitative analysis revealed that CUL-3-actomyosin-dependent oriented division is the only one of these three pathways that regulates the AB division axis before anaphase. Actomyosin-dependent oriented division and eggshell geometry were both required for Phase I rotation, whereas Phase II rotation was independent of eggshell geometry. We further identified the Ras-MAPK signaling pathway as a regulator of AB cell rotation that acts independently of eggshell geometry. Strikingly, the CUL-3-actomyosin-dependent pathway may have two distinct roles: first, specifying the AB division axis, and second, correcting the division axis in all cell types during cytokinesis. Together, these functions contribute significantly to cellular rotation and dorsal-ventral axis establishment.

items.title: Phase-Based Frequency Tracking and Analysis of Vocalisations in the Genus Saxicola
items.title_zh: 基于相位的 Saxicola 属发声频率跟踪与分析
items.summary_zh: 声学分析为研究鸟类发声提供了有价值的工具，但当频率和幅度随时间共同变化时，叫声结构的定量表征仍然具有挑战性。我们提出一种基于相位的频率跟踪方法，将幅度表示为瞬时频率的函数，并用它来表征 Saxicola 属的警报叫声。该方法能够提取描述单个叫声频率轨迹和时间结构的声学特征。我们将该方法应用于代表 15 个物种的 49 个录音中的 801 个叫声数据集，并使用主成分分析（PCA）和稳健 PCA 研究跨物种、录音和地理区域的声学变异模式。结果证明了该方法的可行性，并揭示了所分析叫声之间声学相似性和变异的结构化模式。稳健 PCA 将低秩表示的方差集中到比应用于原始特征矩阵的传统 PCA 更少的主成分中，提供了主导声学结构的补充表示。观察到的模式说明了定量声学表征在发声变异比较研究中的潜力。然而，物种代表性不均以及个体身份和分类标签的不确定性限制了从当前数据集可以得出的生物学结论。该方法为进一步的

extra.description: Acoustic analysis provides valuable tools for studying bird vocalisations, but quantitative characterisation of call structure remains challenging when frequency and amplitude vary jointly over time. We present a phase-based frequency tracking method that represents amplitude as a function of instantaneous frequency and use it to characterise alarm calls in the genus Saxicola. The method enables the extraction of acoustic features describing the frequency trajectory and temporal structure of individual calls. We apply the method to a dataset of 801 calls from 49 recordings representing 15 species, and use principal component analysis (PCA) and robust PCA to investigate patterns of acoustic variation across species, recordings and geographic regions. The results demonstrate the feasibility of the approach and reveal structured patterns of acoustic similarity and variation among the calls analysed. Robust PCA concentrates the variance of the low-rank representation into fewer principal components than conventional PCA applied to the original feature matrix, providing a complementary representation of the dominant acoustic structure. The observed patterns illustrate the potential of quantitative acoustic characterisation for comparative studies of vocal variation. However, uneven species representation and uncertainty in individual identity and taxonomic labels limit the biological conclusions that can be drawn from the present dataset. The method provides a foundation for further acoustic research, in which broader sampling and integration with independent genetic and morphological evidence could help investigate variation within and among species.

items.title: 前 9 月居民用电十年来首现负增长，可能受哪些因素影响？
items.title_zh: 前 9 月居民用电十年来首现负增长，可能受哪些因素影响？
items.summary_zh: 10月21日，国家能源局发布最新全国电力消费数据。一组值得留意的数据是，2026年1-9月，全国城乡居民生活用电量12346亿千瓦时，同比下降0.3%。 第一财经记者通过官方数据梳理发现，这是近十年该统计口径下，1-9月居民用电累计增速首次由正转负。 与之形成对照的是，全社会用电依然维持稳定增长，1-9月全社会用电量 80734亿千瓦时，同比增长 3.9%，增长动力集中在工业、高技术制造以及数字、充换电等服务业。 分月来看，这一轮居民用电的重要拐点出现在9月。9月单月城乡居民生活用电量1210亿千瓦时，同比下降6.0%，下拉了前8个月微弱的正增长。国家能源局介绍，这“主要原因是受‘沙德尔’台风等极端天气影响，9月上中旬华中、华东、南方等高负荷区域降温用电需求下降”。 另据中国电力企业联合会（下称“中电联”）统计与数智部主任助理吴立强分析，受去年同期气温基数较高影响，城乡居民生活用电量较8月

items.summary_zh: 特斯拉第三季度营收280.5亿美元，同比下降0.2%，预估281.3亿美元，其中汽车部门营收205.6亿美元，同比下降3%；第三季度经营利润7.18亿美元，同比下降56%，预估5.993亿美元；调整后每股收益0.48美元，预估0.44美元。公司第三季度毛利率19.6％，上年同期18％，预估17.8％。 公司第三季度资本支出47.3亿美元，上年同期22.5亿美元，预估79.5亿美元；自由现金流15.3亿美元，同比下降62%，预估为-49.9亿美元。

items.title: 女子地铁站内看书 5 个小时被扣 15 元，怎么看待地铁超时收费？其中读书空间等消费场景的设置合理吗？
items.title_zh: 女子地铁站内看书 5 个小时被扣 15 元，怎么看待地铁超时收费？其中读书空间等消费场景的设置合理吗？
items.summary_zh: 近日，市民方女士（化姓）向记者反映，她在地铁站内设置的读书空间看书，停留近5小时，出站时被扣除15元“超时费”。 记者以乘客身份致电广州地铁，工作人员称，广州地铁确实设有270分钟（4小时30分）的乘车时限规定，“地铁是让人快速搭乘通过的地方，不是让人长时间滞留的场景”。对于地铁站内存在的消费场景，工作人员表示，乘客仍需根据自身行程对停留时间进行综合考量。 站内停留一下午，出站被扣15元 此前，方女士搭乘18号线抵达番禺广场站，本打算直接出站，路过地铁站内一处读书空间时临时起意，读完一整本书才离开，前后停留约5个小时。“除了当次车费，还额外被扣了15元，我这才知道有超时费。”林女士说。 有网友被扣15元超时费 无独有偶，另一网友也有类似遭遇。该网友家住花都区，近期正在求职，几乎每天都要前往广州各区面试。“昨天上午去天河区面试，面完之后就在站内找个位置坐着继续投简历，想着有合适的岗位，就可以

items.title: 高校发倡议规范使用得体庄重的「老师」称谓，严禁学生称辅导员为「哥、姐」，你怎么看？
items.title_zh: 高校发倡议规范使用得体庄重的「老师」称谓，严禁学生称辅导员为「哥、姐」，你怎么看？
items.summary_zh: 10月21日，辽宁一高校某学院发出一则关于规范师生称谓的倡议：即日起，严禁以“哥、姐”称呼教职工及辅导员老师，统一使用得体庄重的“老师”称谓。 这份倡议书提及，“老师”这个称谓是对教师职业身份最基础、最庄重的确认。它不仅是简单的语言符号，更承载着学生对知识传授者的敬意与认可，保持这一正式称谓，既是恪守礼仪底线的体现，也是维护教育严肃性的必要举措。而在日常校园生活与师生交流中，随意将辅导员、任课老师称呼为“哥、姐”的现象十分突出，这种看似亲昵的称呼，实则消解了师生间应有的庄重感与边界感，模糊了教育者与受教育者的角色定位。不符合校园文明规范，不利于维护严谨端正的学风校风。全体学生应自查自纠、相互提醒，摒弃随意化、不规范的称呼习惯，将尊师有礼内化于心、外化于行。 在这之前，也有高校发文提及，师生之间以兄弟姐妹相称的不良风气已逐渐侵蚀到大学校园。相关学院领导认为，日常生活中总能见到同学们称呼老师“

items.title: 曝某明星长期借不到高定，自费购买礼服后引该品牌PR暴怒，可能会是谁？为啥自费购买也会引起高奢品牌不满？
items.title_zh: 曝某明星长期借不到高定，自费购买礼服后引该品牌PR暴怒，可能会是谁？为啥自费购买也会引起高奢品牌不满？
items.summary_zh: 曝艺人自费高定。起因是长期借不到高定引发粉丝不满，圈内猜测指向个别90花 | 高定借不到，可以自己买。几十万一条，买完先跟品牌借件样衣穿，成衣得等半年才到你手上。 今天凌晨一个时尚博主爆的料：有艺人一口气买了两条顶级高定，起因是工作室长期借不到，粉丝在评论区闹了很久。全程没点名，一上午网友忙着猜，被点到名的几家粉丝晒别家物料自证。 借高定这道门，看的是品牌对你商业价值、作品、形象适配的判断，跟你有多少钱没关系。借衣要提前发函，品牌裁缝飞过来量体改衣，穿完专人核验，蹭破一点要赔。全球拿到法国高级时装工会认证的高定品牌，不到50家。 所以“穿上高定”和“借到高定”是两件事：前者靠钱，后者靠牌面。自费买，圈内话叫补票。 买完当场还穿不了。高定按你身材现做，工期半年起，先跟品牌借一件样衣上台，成衣好了再还回去。钱大概率也不是她自己想花。粉丝天天在评论区问“姐姐的高定呢”，工作室的压力就压在这条裙子

items.title: 印度男子谋杀39岁中国女子被终身监禁，交往期间谎称是模特和演员，实则是工地临时工，哪些细节值得关注？
items.title_zh: 印度男子谋杀39岁中国女子被终身监禁，交往期间谎称是模特和演员，实则是工地临时工，哪些细节值得关注？
items.summary_zh: 近日，据多家媒体报道，一名印度籍男子持学生签证赴英，因谋杀一名中国女性，被判处终身监禁，最低服刑期为28年。 报道称，这名印度男子现年24岁，于2025年杀害了39岁的中国女子，死者被刺了30多刀。两人相识后发展成恋人关系，使用翻译软件进行沟通。 据报道，受害人有两个孩子。交往期间，该男子伪造身份，谎称自己是模特和演员。然而，实际上，该男子于2024年9月入境英国，因出勤率不佳被大学课程除名，学生签证约6个月后被吊销，他一直在建筑工地做临时工。 之后，受害人发现该男子一直撒谎，还多次偷取她的财物、拿走她的手机，甚至扣留她的护照，于是提出分手。该男子持续纠缠受害人，并以承诺还钱为由说服她见面，而实际上是想报复。该男子在案发前购买了刀具。作案后，他购买了一张飞往孟买的机票，但在前往机场途中被捕。印度籍男子在英国杀害中国女子，被判终身监禁最低服刑28年

items.title: 如何评价宇树发布全新机器人「H2-X功夫传奇 守护」，宣称能徒手抬车、勇斗歹徒？在实际生活中会用在哪？
items.title_zh: 如何评价宇树发布全新机器人「H2-X功夫传奇 守护」，宣称能徒手抬车、勇斗歹徒？在实际生活中会用在哪？
items.summary_zh: 机器人前瞻10月21日报道，刚刚，宇树科技发布新款人形机器人“H2-X功夫传奇 守护”。官方发布的视频显示，该机器人最长续航时间可达约8小时，可以徒手抬起汽车、从4米高空平稳落地、一脚踢凹车门。 宇树发布的视频中，H2-X可以一脚跨到汽车顶部，再从上面翻身而下，动作丝滑。 机器人一脚踹向汽车后，车门处可以看到大块明显凹陷，其用胳膊肘击汽车前盖，也能看到凹痕。 H2-X还在视频中从4米高台一跃而下，并在落地后向前翻滚并稳稳站起。 机器人还可以在连续多次腾空飞踢后，平稳落地。 视频中，H2-X还上演了一段大战歹徒、保护主人的戏份。 当人形模特被压到汽车下时，机器人能“徒手”抬起汽车前部，直至工作人员将模特拖出。 最后，当汽车即将碰到站立在路中的人形模特时，机器人会迅速飞扑，将人形模特推开。 该机器人续航达8小时，同时支持高强度爆发动作，这也进一步打破了行业的固有认知，高动态人形机器人不一定是耗

items.title: 《offer 8》嘉宾称「专博期间不上临床」被质疑，福医大称其已完成18个月临床轮转，如何看待此事？
items.title_zh: 《offer 8》嘉宾称「专博期间不上临床」被质疑，福医大称其已完成18个月临床轮转，如何看待此事？
items.summary_zh: 《令人心动的offer8》李子祺被质疑学术造假，在节目中称“博士期间不上临床”引争议。 10月21日，福建医科大学工作人员向潇湘晨报·晨视频记者表示，校方已核查情况，“博士期间不上临床”一说，是李子祺表达不当造成的误解，该生已完成18个月临床轮转。学校纪委工作人员同时透露，目前暂未收到关于李子祺学术造假的相关举报。《令人心动的offer8》嘉宾李子祺称“博士期间不上临床”，被疑学术造假；福建医科大学回应：系表达不当造成误解，其已完成18个月临床轮转_腾讯新闻 综艺播出了，反而让医学生处境变难，这类职场综艺真的有正面意义吗？

items.title: 留美在读女博士答辩失利，向实验室同门咖啡机投毒「丙烯酰胺」，如何看待这一事件？
items.title_zh: 留美在读女博士答辩失利，向实验室同门咖啡机投毒「丙烯酰胺」，如何看待这一事件？
items.summary_zh: 据 10 月 13 日报道，32 岁的中国生物学准博士王爱丽（Aili Wang，音译），涉嫌多次向同事咖啡壶中投放有毒化学物质，导致对方出现手脚麻木、腿部无力、疲劳，失眠等神经中毒症状，至今仍未康复。 而她涉嫌使用的这种物质，各位研究生们再熟悉不过了，正是 Western blot 实验中都会用到的丙烯酰胺。 随后，王爱丽于 10 月 6 日准备返回国内时，在洛杉矶国际机场被警方逮捕。 王爱丽 图源：http://cowboystatedaily.com 毕业答辩未通过，博士生用实验试剂给同门投毒 据警方调查，该起投毒案件发生在怀俄明大学（University of Wyoming），受害人是化名「K.T.」的越南籍研究生，他与嫌疑人王爱丽均在 Mark Gomelsky 教授课题组学习。 Mark Gomelsky 图源：http://uwyo.edu Mark Gomelsky 教授

items.title: 日本关键稀土钇储备将耗尽，求助美国敦促中方放宽管制，稀土将耗尽一事将对日方产生多大影响？
items.title_zh: 日本关键稀土钇储备将耗尽，求助美国敦促中方放宽管制，稀土将耗尽一事将对日方产生多大影响？
items.summary_zh: 据英国《金融时报》10月20日报道，有知情人士透露，日本关键金属钇的供应仅能维持数月，已经请求美国协助劝说中方放宽稀土出口管制，以避免制造业停产。 一位日本政府官员称：“（我们）所谈论的时间表不是以年计，而是以月计，眼下要考虑的是如何熬过明年。”(环球时报记者 郑璇) 10月21日，外交部发言人毛宁主持例行记者会。 法新社记者提问，据报道，日本关键稀土元素钇的储备即将耗尽，仅能维持数月。日方已请求美国协助，敦促中国放宽相关的出口管制。请问外交部对此有何评论？ 毛宁指出，中方依法依规对日本实施出口管制，目的是制止日本“再军事化”和拥核企图。中方维护关键矿产全球产供链稳定与安全的立场没有变化，各方都有责任为此发挥建设性作用。日本请求美国协助敦促中方放宽稀土管制，中方回应 | 极目新闻英媒：日本关键稀土仅够维持数月，日本已请求美国劝说中方放宽稀土出口管制

items.title: 为啥智谱GLM海外口碑极佳，国内认知度却不及豆包DeepSeek？盈利模式、应用场景上三者有啥区别吗？
items.title_zh: 为啥智谱GLM海外口碑极佳，国内认知度却不及豆包DeepSeek？盈利模式、应用场景上三者有啥区别吗？
items.summary_zh: 为什么技术实力雄厚、海外口碑扎实的智谱，在国内的大众认知中，却似乎被 DeepSeek 和豆包甩在了身后。在海外，GLM 的口碑之所以好，是因为海外的开源社区和学术圈看重的是论文质量、模型开源程度以及 API 的稳定性。智谱清言虽然也面向 C 端，但在字节庞大的流量机器和产品矩阵面前，声量自然显得微弱——2025 年初，智谱清言的月活尚在数百万级别，与豆包不在同一个量级。 智谱的困惑：海外口碑极佳的GLM，为何在国内大众眼里输给了DeepSeek和豆包？-36氪https://36kr.com/p/4033871744767872
